description: Verify a GYOTAK catch record DIRECTLY from the Midnight blockchain. Reads on-chain state and returns the raw hex plus decoded fields for independent verification. Unlike get_catch_reports (GYOTAK's own list of records: date, district and verify links, never GPS), this lets you verify without trusting GYOTAK. The exact position is not on the chain (only a commitment to it). The region name is a label set by GYOTAK. GYOTAK checks the region range when recording, but the range used is not part of the record, so a third party cannot confirm it from the chain. Supports both preprod and mainnet. batchId also accepts several IDs separated by commas: they are all checked against a single fetch of the contract state, and the response lists found/not-found per ID.

batchId.description: Filter to a specific catch record by batchId (e.g. "CR-20261021-37b2b7be"). Omit to return all records in the contract.
